description:
The XREAL Aura is more Galaxy XR than smart glasses, in concept: It’s an AR/VR headset that you can take on the go. The glasses connect with a USB-C cable to an included processor puck that runs Android XR, and can display Android apps in both 2D and 3D immersive.
